go_condition: new assets live in a dated Goal-specific bundle; accepted Goal 005/016/017/019/020/021/022 assets are read-only provenance
no_go_condition: method requires overwriting or silently revising accepted assets
validation_evidence_required: git status/diff confirms no accepted asset overwrite; provenance table maps inputs to outputs

go_condition: protocol can be prototyped from existing compact arrays and/or synthetic fixtures without HDF5/XRAiSE rerun
no_go_condition: protocol cannot be evaluated without remote HDF5 extraction or production compute
validation_evidence_required: local script/tests or documented manual evidence; no remote paths read

go_condition: method reports both side-aware tracer-proxy labels and connected-envelope/single-system classification where applicable
no_go_condition: method collapses topology into one interpretation without recording alternative or confidence
validation_evidence_required: machine-readable topology classification table with criteria and confidence labels

go_condition: X-ray/topology mask rule is deterministic, parameterized, and stable under documented local contrast/residual settings
no_go_condition: mask depends on subjective hand-drawn boundaries or untracked display choices
validation_evidence_required: synthetic/local tests plus parseable metadata recording thresholds/kernels/morphology operations

go_condition: pV, adopted 2.5pV, 4pV, one-sided/bipolar labels, and Level 3 gravity blocker remain explicit
no_go_condition: method changes energy interpretation or drops the adopted convention without review
validation_evidence_required: energy/caveat row in metadata and science note

go_condition: local/synthetic method gate passes and X-ray Cavities authorizes a bounded existing-output rerun explicitly
no_go_condition: method package implies or starts remote compute by default
validation_evidence_required: future goal packet with explicit paths, no-overwrite policy, validation gates, and PBS stop rule

go_condition: tracer threshold, projection method, XRAiSE physics, source ages, and energy conventions are unchanged unless reviewed
no_go_condition: method requires changing physical/scientific defaults inside a local implementation goal
validation_evidence_required: metadata states defaults unchanged and lists any reviewed exceptions
